note: Every diagnostic the court can raise by itself. A code is never reused. The codes of TERM, WORDLIST, PATTERN and PROFILE rules belong to the style that declares them.

UNEXPECTED_TOKEN.invariant: A .proz file is a sequence of USE lines and DEFINE declarations.

UNTERMINATED_STRING.summary: A quoted string is not closed on its line.
UNTERMINATED_STRING.invariant: A string opens and closes on one line.

UNKNOWN_KIND.summary: {kind} is not a kind of declaration.
UNKNOWN_KIND.invariant: The kinds are closed: STYLE, TERM, WORDLIST, PATTERN, PROFILE, FORM, ZONE, PIECE, ALLOW, READING.

UNKNOWN_FIELD.invariant: Each kind has a closed list of fields.

DUPLICATE_FIELD.invariant: A field stands once in a declaration.

DUPLICATE_DECLARATION.summary: The name {name} is already declared at line {first}.
DUPLICATE_DECLARATION.invariant: A name is declared once across all kinds.

MISSING_FIELD.invariant: A declaration carries its required fields.

BAD_VALUE.summary: The value of {field} is not lawful: {why}.
BAD_VALUE.invariant: A field's value has the shape its kind declares.

RULE_WITHOUT_EVIDENCE.summary: This {kind} carries no EVIDENCE: a rule enters on a dated ruling or a measure.
RULE_WITHOUT_EVIDENCE.invariant: Every rule cites the ruling or the measure it comes from.

UNKNOWN_REFERENCE.summary: {field} names {name}, which is not a declared {kinds}.
UNKNOWN_REFERENCE.invariant: A reference names a declaration of the right kind.

ADOPTION_CYCLE.invariant: Adoption and extension form no cycle.

TERM_REFUSED_AND_REQUIRED.summary: The style {style} asks for "{word}" and refuses it in {rule}.
TERM_REFUSED_AND_REQUIRED.invariant: A style never refuses the word it asks for.

EXAMPLE_NOT_REFUSED.summary: The REFUSED example is not refused by its own pattern: "{text}".
EXAMPLE_NOT_REFUSED.invariant: A pattern refuses its own refused example.

EXAMPLE_NOT_LAWFUL.summary: The WRITTEN example is refused by its own pattern: "{text}".
EXAMPLE_NOT_LAWFUL.invariant: A pattern accepts its own written example.

PIECE_WITHOUT_SUBJECT.summary: The form {form} places the subject, and the piece declares no SUBJECT.
PIECE_WITHOUT_SUBJECT.invariant: A piece whose form places the subject declares it.

BOUND_INVERTED.summary: The bound of {field} has its lower end above its upper end.
BOUND_INVERTED.invariant: A bound's lower end is at most its upper end.

TITLE_TOO_LONG.summary: The title holds {n} words; the form allows {max}.
TITLE_TOO_LONG.invariant: A title names its subject in few words.

TITLE_MISSING.invariant: A governed text has a title.

TITLE_WITHOUT_SUBJECT.summary: The title does not name the subject "{subject}".

LEDE_WITHOUT_SUBJECT.summary: The first sentence does not name the subject "{subject}".
LEDE_WITHOUT_SUBJECT.invariant: The first sentence names the subject and says what it is.

SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND.summary: The piece takes its subject from the front matter, and the page declares none.

SAY_ONCE.summary: "{pair}" stands twice in the first {limit} words (first at line {first}).
SAY_ONCE.invariant: A statement is made once per screen.

HEADING_MISSING.invariant: A form's fixed headings are all present.

HEADING_OUT_OF_ORDER.summary: The heading "{heading}" stands before a heading the form places ahead of it.
HEADING_OUT_OF_ORDER.invariant: A form's fixed headings keep their order.

HEADING_NOT_SENTENCE_CASE.invariant: A heading is written in sentence case.

CLOSES_ON_SUMMARY.invariant: A text closes on something new for its reader.

HOLE_OPEN.summary: A hole is still open at status {status}: {hole}
HOLE_OPEN.invariant: A hole is closed by the author before the text is reviewed.

ALLOW_STALE.summary: This ALLOW excuses {code} on a line holding "{holds}", and no such finding stands.
ALLOW_STALE.invariant: An excuse lives as long as the line it excuses.

PIECE_FILE_NOT_FOUND.summary: The piece names {path}, and no such file stands.
PIECE_FILE_NOT_FOUND.invariant: A piece names a text that exists.

TERM_SYNONYM.summary: A refused word stands for a declared term.

OFF_PROFILE.summary: A measure of the text stands outside the declared profile.
OFF_PROFILE.invariant: A text keeps the measure of its voice.
